{{Top|leg}}
'''Exalted''' was a title given to the greatest and oldest of the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]]. The Exalted was the only living being permitted to enter the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]]. The position was permanent: Once Exalted, always Exalted.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Feln]] was the Exalted in [[3963 BBY]]. But when he destroyed the Sanctum, destroying the village, [[Borjak]] stabbed him with a knife and his people turned on him. Borjak then became the new Exalted.
